candidate_interpretation: An 'unread: instrument refusal' state is not a finding about the corpus. It is an execution state that the object schema has no closed value for.
confirm_or_refute: Confirmed if the same refusal repeats under an activated plan; refuted if a governed value for 'not determined: source unread' already exists that this run should have used.
exact_observation: The only required source, S1014, could not be read because the reader refused page 1 (REFUSED: no activated R7 plan for this batch). The closed values for births.<kind>, timeline_summary.current_lifecycle and stage2_dispositions[].method cannot say 'not determined because the source was refused'. NOT-EVIDENCED-IN-CAPTURE, WHOLE-FILE and STAGE-2A-2B would each assert something false.

proposed_topic_definitions.PROPOSED:UNREAD-STATE-UNREPRESENTABLE: A required source was not read because of an instrument refusal, and a closed object-schema field has no value that represents 'undetermined because unread'.

significance: Without such a value an agent must either set a field to null (as done here) or assert a reading state that did not occur.
source_evidence: S1014: file-level only; no page was witnessed.
statement: The closed values for births, current_lifecycle and the stage-2 disposition method cannot represent a required source left unread after a reader refusal. Those fields are null in this run's object.
why_insufficient: births.<kind> offers only ESTABLISHED, MOVED, UNORDERED-BLOCK, BIRTH-UNRESOLVED-MTIME-ONLY, TIMESTAMP-ANOMALY, G-08 or NOT-EVIDENCED-IN-CAPTURE, and each of these needs the file to be inspected. stage2_dispositions[].method offers only WHOLE-FILE or STAGE-2A-2B.

component_affected: R7 reader default-deny (addendum §2.4) and the activation state of the OB0012 R7 plan
conflict: The dispatch assigns S1014 to this run and requires every page to be read, but the reader refused the canonical invocation with 'REFUSED: no activated R7 plan for this batch'. Under §5.1 W4 a refused event is a stop condition, so this run's reading obligations cannot be met.
evidence: Reader call at step 1, page 1, S1014, run OB0012-R7-L05: exit code 1, output 'REFUSED: no activated R7 plan for this batch'. No further reader call was made.

proposed_topic_definitions.PROPOSED:INSTRUMENT-REFUSAL: The corpus reader refused a canonical, in-scope read for an execution-state reason (such as plan activation), not a content reason.

statement: The batch was dispatched while the reader reports no activated R7 plan for OB0012. Every reading run of the batch is likely to be refused in the same way. This is an instrument or environment cause (class X), not a finding about the corpus.
suggested_remedy: Activate the OB0012 R7 plan (manifest r7_plan_sha256 binding) before dispatch, then rerun as a governed attempt under §2.8.
